description.summary: BusyBox applets that need root privileges
description.p: The BusyBox binary is not installed setuid root. This package has a small setuid program instead, which runs BusyBox for a fixed list of applets and nothing else: mount, umount, su, crontab, passwd, traceroute, traceroute6 and vlock. Without it, these only work for root.

maintainer-scripts.prerm: # The links belong to no package. Once they are gone, the trigger of the # busybox package points the names back to busybox. if [ "$1" = "remove" ]; then for DIR in /usr/bin /usr/sbin; do for LINK in "$DIR"/*; do if [ ! -L "$LINK" ]; then continue fi if [ "$(/bin/busybox readlink "$LINK")" = "/bin/bbsuid" ]; then /bin/busybox rm -f "$LINK" fi done done fi
